current_state_facts.summary: Desktop AS-IS homepage evidence is captured for entry-center baseline comparison.
Mobile AS-IS homepage evidence is captured for responsive baseline comparison.
Visible current homepage text evidence is captured for login, renewal, download, support, and announcement entry traceability.
No project-local package.json, Vite, or Next.js frontend app configuration was found within the searched repository depth; no usable real frontend app is proven available for this phase.

architecture_significant_requirements.requirement: Provide a reviewable homepage entry center prototype for login, renewal, download, support, announcement, and responsive behavior.
Do not introduce real backend, payment, download, support, announcement backend, tracking, auth, release, or rollback integration.
Desktop and mobile review paths must keep core entry intents visible without overlap or loss of hierarchy.

option_analysis.name: static prototype
option_analysis.summary: Implement the phase surface as static HTML/CSS/JS under the phase prototype directory.
option_analysis.tradeoff: Fast, local, reviewable, and reversible; does not reuse a production frontend because none is proven available in this repository.
option_analysis.boundary_effect: All interactions remain prototype_only and not_integrated.

option_analysis.name: existing frontend stack
option_analysis.summary: Build the entry center inside a real existing frontend app if such app is available.
option_analysis.tradeoff: Could prove closer production integration, but would exceed this repo's proven available runtime and would risk implying real integration beyond PM scope.
option_analysis.boundary_effect: Rejected for this phase unless a real 全房通 frontend app and integration boundary are provided by upstream.

key_decisions.summary: Use static prototype as the implementation surface for UNIT-1.
failure_conditions: A real, runnable 全房通 frontend app is provided in scope and upstream refreshes the task boundaries.
The acceptance target changes from prototype review to production integration.
key_decisions.user_confirmation: covered by the Task 4 dispatch boundary and PM prototype-only scope

key_decisions.summary: Keep every backend-facing action local to visible prototype feedback.
failure_conditions: Any downstream task needs real login, payment, download, support, announcement backend, tracking, auth, release, or rollback integration.
key_decisions.user_confirmation: covered by PM exclusions and Task 4 instruction

modules.responsibility: Arrange the entry center hierarchy so login, renewal, download, support, and announcement intents are visible on first review.
protected_behaviors: No production navigation, release, rollback, auth, tracking, or backend calls.

modules.responsibility: Expose password, verification-code, and QR login states with visible active selection and boundary messaging.
protected_behaviors: real login remains prototype_only and not_integrated
No credential submission, auth session, or backend request.

modules.responsibility: Show renewal prompt state and allow acknowledge/dismiss/restore feedback inside the prototype.
protected_behaviors: real renewal payment remains prototype_only and not_integrated
No payment page, payment API, or account billing change.

modules.responsibility: Provide a client download entry that returns visible prototype feedback when clicked.
protected_behaviors: real client download remains prototype_only and not_integrated
No external download or file transfer.

modules.responsibility: Provide a support entry that returns visible prototype feedback when clicked.
protected_behaviors: real support system remains prototype_only and not_integrated
No chat, phone gateway, ticketing, or external support integration.

modules.responsibility: Display announcement content or expansion feedback without relying on a backend announcement source.
protected_behaviors: real announcement backend remains prototype_only and not_integrated
No announcement API, CMS, or notification tracking.

modules.responsibility: Provide desktop two-area and mobile single-column shell behavior for browser review.
protected_behaviors: production responsive release remains prototype_only and not_integrated
No deployment, release, rollback, telemetry, or production monitoring integration.

interface_contracts.input: Browser click on password, verification-code, or QR login tab.
interface_contracts.output: Active tab state, matching panel text, and prototype_only/not_integrated boundary message are visible.
interface_contracts.error_or_boundary_behavior: Repeated or rapid tab clicks keep the last selected tab visible and never submit credentials or call auth services.

interface_contracts.input: Browser click on acknowledge, dismiss, or restore control.
interface_contracts.output: Renewal prompt status visibly changes inside the prototype.
interface_contracts.error_or_boundary_behavior: Dismissed state can be restored during the same review path; no payment capability is invoked.

interface_contracts.input: Browser click on download, support, or announcement entry.
interface_contracts.output: Visible prototype feedback or announcement content appears.
interface_contracts.error_or_boundary_behavior: Repeated clicks only update local prototype feedback and never trigger external download, support, CMS, or tracking calls.

data_and_state.refresh_behavior: Refresh resets to documented default prototype state; no persisted user data is expected.

cross_cutting_concerns.decision: Prototype controls must not collect real credentials, tokens, account data, payment data, support payloads, or tracking identifiers.
No production telemetry or tracking is introduced; evidence is browser screenshot and interaction record only.
No production release or rollback path exists for this phase artifact; downstream signoff must treat it as prototype-only documentation and static prototype work.

real announcement backend remains prototype_only and not_integrated

risk_response.response: Keep every backend-facing expectation marked prototype_only or not_integrated in design, test-design, developer report, QA, and signoff artifacts.

planning_constraints: Developer scope should stay within phase-1/prototype files and developer-report once Task 6 is issued.
QA must use real_browser evidence for acceptance paths, not Mock-based proof of integration.
Backend integration, tracking, auth, release, and rollback are excluded from this phase.

handoff.to_test_design: Generate real_browser obligations for all UNIT-1 AC with desktop/mobile, repeat click, and refresh recovery coverage.
handoff.to_tech_lead: Plan a static prototype implementation and keep backend-facing tasks out of developer scope.
handoff.to_developer: Implement local UI state only; no network calls, external navigation, credential submission, payment, download, support, announcement backend, tracking, auth, release, or rollback integration.
handoff.to_qa: Verify visible prototype behavior and boundary messaging in desktop and mobile browsers.
